label: 本次扣款未在期限内完成
description: 当前时间超过余额抵扣请求（request.prepaid）的截止时间，且期限内没有恰好一份身份、金额、币种和扣后余额均匹配的成功结果（confirmation.prepaid）时，判定余额抵扣履约（fulfillment.prepaid）逾期。
expression:
now > request.expired_at && !(confirmations.filter(c, c.request_id
== request.request_id && c.subscription_id ==
request.subscription_id && c.reader_id == request.reader_id &&
c.column_id == request.column_id && c.confirmed_at >=
request.started_at && c.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at &&
c.payment_request_id == request.payment_request_id &&
c.amount_minor_units == request.amount_minor_units && c.currency ==
request.currency && c.success && request.balance_before_minor_units
>= request.amount_minor_units && c.balance_after_minor_units ==
request.balance_before_minor_units - c.amount_minor_units &&
c.balance_after_minor_units >= 0).size() == 1)
